question:
**Replace the underlined segment with the most appropriate idiom/phrase from the following options.**

This is the __critical point of the issue__. One should always be focused on it.
solution:
The correct answer is **'The crux of the matter'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate idiom to replace the underlined segment **"critical point" **in the given sentence is: The crux of the matt
